name: Voice Actions
description: Say a trigger word to open apps and websites, then have it stripped from what gets pasted. Its settings render right inside the Snippets tab — no separate window. A worked example of the transform hook, the open:url / open:app capabilities, and the reusable declarative list UI.

settings.label: Voice actions
settings.description: Say a trigger and Grain opens its websites and apps, then removes the trigger from your text.
